notes.title: 🔔“Sounds Good” Update
notes.content:
Thanks to the creative work of our audio partners, we’ve added various interaction sounds to all props in the game, making the gameplay more fun.
Besides that, we’ve also replaced some sound effects with better designs and fixed some bugs.
